{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hex Wraith''' was a tanky enemy that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had high health, higher than all enemies that appeared before it, while also being quite fast for its health. On some waves, it could spawn with the [[Bloated]], [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] and [[Aggro]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Hex Wraith''' had maroon skin with neon red eyes. It had multiple holes in its body, revealing lava inside its body. It wore a grey chestplate and shoulder-pads. On its right arm, it wore a grey armband with a blade attached to it. ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Militant]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be used to kill this quickly. *On some waves, the '''Hex Wraith''' will spawn with [[Aggro]], making it force towers to target it. **Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful here. **The [[Trapper]] can be useful in such situations, as while it will still target it, its traps will damage any enemies that get past the [[Aggro]] '''Hex Wraith'''. Similarly, unit collisions can also be effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} HexWraithWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight2Thumbnail.png|'''Hex Wraith''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} HexscapeNight2DiscordThumbnail.png|'''Hex Wraith''' on a render. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Hex Wraith''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex Wraith''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex Wraith''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Hex Spawn]] & [[Hex Minion]]|Wave 1|Hex Wraith|Wave 2|[[Hex Revenant]]|Wave 5}} {{Containment|[[Hex Spawn]] & [[Hex Minion]]|Wave 1|Hex Wraith|Wave 2|[[Hex Revenant]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
